views.name: rombot_context
views.def:
SELECT u.id AS user_id,
    u.full_name,
    u.belt,
    u.platforms,
    u.portal_role,
    u.subscription_status,
    a.id AS latest_assessment_id,
    a.assessed_at,
    a.rom_total,
    a.rom_percentile,
    a.worst_joints,
    a.red_flag_triggered,
    a.red_flag_reasons,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('joint', js.joint_key, 'score', js.score, 'left', js.left_value, 'right', js.right_value, 'asymmetry_pct', js.asymmetry_pct, 'flag', js.asymmetry_flag) ORDER BY js.joint_key) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM joint_scores js
          WHERE (js.assessment_id = a.id)) AS joint_scores,
    ( SELECT jsonb_build_object('green', count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((te.tier = 'GREEN'::text) AND (te.flag IS NULL))), 'yellow', count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((te.tier = 'YELLOW'::text) AND (te.flag IS NULL))), 'red', count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((te.tier = 'RED'::text) OR (te.flag = 'DELAY_TECHNIQUE'::text)))) AS jsonb_build_object
           FROM technique_eligibility te
          WHERE ((te.user_id = u.id) AND (te.assessment_id = a.id))) AS technique_summary,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', t.name, 'belt', t.belt, 'category', t.category, 'limiting_joints', te.limiting_joints)) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (technique_eligibility te
             JOIN techniques t ON ((t.id = te.technique_id)))
          WHERE ((te.user_id = u.id) AND (te.assessment_id = a.id) AND ((te.tier = 'RED'::text) OR (te.flag = 'DELAY_TECHNIQUE'::text)))
         LIMIT 10) AS red_techniques,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', t.name, 'category', t.category, 'belt', t.belt) ORDER BY t.category, t.name) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (technique_eligibility te
             JOIN techniques t ON ((t.id = te.technique_id)))
          WHERE ((te.user_id = u.id) AND (te.assessment_id = a.id) AND (te.tier = 'GREEN'::text) AND (te.flag IS NULL))) AS green_techniques,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', t.name, 'category', t.category, 'belt', t.belt, 'limiting_joints', te.limiting_joints) ORDER BY t.category, t.name) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (technique_eligibility te
             JOIN techniques t ON ((t.id = te.technique_id)))
          WHERE ((te.user_id = u.id) AND (te.assessment_id = a.id) AND (te.tier = 'YELLOW'::text) AND (te.flag IS NULL))) AS yellow_techniques,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('joint', p.joint_key, 'rank', p.priority_rank, 'exercise',
                CASE
                    WHEN a.is_base THEN regexp_replace(e.name, '\s*[\u2014\u2013]\s*'::text, ', '::text, 'g'::text)
                    ELSE e.name
                END, 'type', e.exercise_type, 'sets', e.sets, 'reps',
                CASE
                    WHEN a.is_base THEN regexp_replace(e.reps, '\s*[\u2014\u2013]\s*'::text, ', '::text, 'g'::text)
                    ELSE e.reps
                END, 'cue',
                CASE
                    WHEN a.is_base THEN regexp_replace(e.coaching_cue, '\s*[\u2014\u2013]\s*'::text, ', '::text, 'g'::text)
                    ELSE e.coaching_cue
                END) ORDER BY p.priority_rank) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM (protocols p
             JOIN exercises e ON ((e.id = p.exercise_id)))
          WHERE ((p.user_id = u.id) AND (p.assessment_id = a.id))) AS protocol,
    ( SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('name', gp.name, 'path_mode', gp.path_mode, 'techniques', gp.techniques, 'created_at', gp.created_at) ORDER BY gp.created_at DESC) AS jsonb_agg
           FROM ( SELECT gp2.id,
                    gp2.user_id,
                    gp2.name,
                    gp2.description,
                    gp2.path_mode,
                    gp2.techniques,
                    gp2.created_at,
                    gp2.updated_at
                   FROM game_plans gp2
                  WHERE (gp2.user_id = u.id)
                  ORDER BY gp2.created_at DESC
                 LIMIT 5) gp) AS saved_game_plans
   FROM (users u
     LEFT JOIN LATERAL ( SELECT assessments.id,
            assessments.user_id,
            assessments.assessed_at,
            assessments.rom_total,
            assessments.rom_percentile,
            assessments.worst_joints,
            assessments.red_flag_triggered,
            assessments.red_flag_reasons,
            (lower(COALESCE(assessments.sport, ''::text)) = ANY (ARRAY['general'::text, 'base'::text])) AS is_base
           FROM assessments
          WHERE (assessments.user_id = u.id)
          ORDER BY assessments.assessed_at DESC
         LIMIT 1) a ON (true));

    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((e.event = 'signup_completed'::text) AND (COALESCE(((e.props ->> 'is_test'::text))::boolean, false) = false))) AS signups,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((e.event = 'assessment_submitted'::text) AND (COALESCE(((e.props ->> 'is_reassessment'::text))::boolean, false) = false))) AS first_assessments,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE ((e.event = 'assessment_submitted'::text) AND ((e.props ->> 'is_reassessment'::text))::boolean)) AS reassessments,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.event = 'base_activated'::text)) AS base_activations,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.event = 'protocol_session_logged'::text)) AS protocol_sessions,
    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.event = 'rombot_message_sent'::text)) AS rombot_messages,

    count(*) FILTER (WHERE (e.event = 'lead_assessment_submitted'::text)) AS lead_assessments
   FROM (product_events e
     RIGHT JOIN generate_series((date_trunc('day'::text, now()) - '89 days'::interval), date_trunc('day'::text, now()), '1 day'::interval) d(d) ON ((date_trunc('day'::text, e.created_at) = d.d)))

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.search_rombot_knowledge(query_embedding vector, p_sport text, match_threshold double precision DEFAULT 0.7, match_count integer DEFAULT 5)
 RETURNS TABLE(id uuid, topic text, chunk text, source_citation text, sport text, similarity double precision)

AS $function$
BEGIN
  RETURN QUERY

    1 - (rk.embedding <=> query_embedding) AS similarity
  FROM public.rombot_knowledge rk

    AND (rk.sport = 'general' OR rk.sport = p_sport)

  LIMIT match_count;

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_joint_history(p_limit integer DEFAULT 20)
 RETURNS TABLE(assessment_id uuid, assessed_at timestamp with time zone, rom_total numeric, joint_key text, score smallint, left_value numeric, right_value numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH mine AS (
    SELECT a.id, COALESCE(a.assessed_at, a.created_at) AS at, a.rom_total
    FROM public.assessments a
    WHERE a.user_id = auth.uid()
    ORDER BY COALESCE(a.assessed_at, a.created_at) DESC
    LIMIT GREATEST(1, LEAST(COALESCE(p_limit, 20), 50))
  )
  SELECT m.id, m.at, m.rom_total, j.joint_key, j.score, j.left_value, j.right_value

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_joint_start_vs_now()
 RETURNS TABLE(joint_key text, first_assessed_at timestamp with time zone, latest_assessed_at timestamp with time zone, first_score smallint, latest_score smallint, first_left numeric, first_right numeric, latest_left numeric, latest_right numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH rows AS (
    SELECT j.joint_key, COALESCE(a.assessed_at, a.created_at) AS at, j.score, j.left_value, j.right_value,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY j.joint_key ORDER BY COALESCE(a.assessed_at, a.created_at) ASC)  AS rn_first,
           row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY j.joint_key ORDER BY COALESCE(a.assessed_at, a.created_at) DESC) AS rn_last
    FROM public.assessments a JOIN public.joint_scores j ON j.assessment_id = a.id
    WHERE a.user_id = auth.uid()
  )
  SELECT f.joint_key, f.at, l.at, f.score, l.score, f.left_value, f.right_value, l.left_value, l.right_value
  FROM rows f JOIN rows l ON l.joint_key = f.joint_key AND l.rn_last = 1
  WHERE f.rn_first = 1 AND f.at < l.at
  ORDER BY f.joint_key;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.my_color_movement(p_sport text)
 RETURNS TABLE(status text, earlier_assessment_id uuid, later_assessment_id uuid, earlier_at timestamp with time zone, later_at timestamp with time zone, total integer, red_to_yellow integer, red_to_green integer, yellow_to_green integer, green_to_yellow integer, yellow_to_red integer, green_to_red integer, unchanged integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH sets AS (
    SELECT te.assessment_id, MAX(COALESCE(a.assessed_at, a.created_at)) AS at
    FROM public.technique_eligibility te JOIN public.assessments a ON a.id = te.assessment_id AND a.user_id = auth.uid()
    WHERE te.user_id = auth.uid() AND te.sport = p_sport
    GROUP BY te.assessment_id
    ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 2
  ), pair AS (
    SELECT (SELECT assessment_id FROM sets ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1) AS later_id, (SELECT at FROM sets ORDER BY at DESC LIMIT 1) AS later_at,
           (SELECT assessment_id FROM sets ORDER BY at ASC LIMIT 1)  AS earlier_id, (SELECT at FROM sets ORDER BY at ASC LIMIT 1)  AS earlier_at,
           (SELECT count(*) FROM sets) AS n
  ), moves AS (
    SELECT e.tier AS t0, l.tier AS t1
    FROM pair p
    JOIN public.technique_eligibility e ON e.assessment_id = p.earlier_id AND e.user_id = auth.uid() AND e.sport = p_sport
    JOIN public.technique_eligibility l ON l.assessment_id = p.later_id  AND l.user_id = auth.uid() AND l.sport = p_sport AND l.technique_id = e.technique_id
    WHERE p.n = 2
  )
  SELECT CASE WHEN p.n = 2 THEN 'ok' ELSE 'insufficient_data' END, CASE WHEN p.n = 2 THEN p.earlier_id END, CASE WHEN p.n = 2 THEN p.later_id END,
         CASE WHEN p.n = 2 THEN p.earlier_at END, CASE WHEN p.n = 2 THEN p.later_at END,
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM moves),
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM moves WHERE t0 = 'RED' AND t1 = 'YELLOW'),
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM moves WHERE t0 = 'RED' AND t1 = 'GREEN'),
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM moves WHERE t0 = 'YELLOW' AND t1 = 'GREEN'),
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM moves WHERE t0 = 'GREEN' AND t1 = 'YELLOW'),
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM moves WHERE t0 = 'YELLOW' AND t1 = 'RED'),
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM moves WHERE t0 = 'GREEN' AND t1 = 'RED'),
         (SELECT count(*)::int FROM moves WHERE t0 = t1)
  FROM pair p;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.protocol_joint_ranking(p_assessment_id uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(joint_key text, priority_rank integer)
 LANGUAGE sql
 STABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH a AS (
    SELECT to_jsonb(x) AS j, x.worst_joints, x.created_at AS a_created,
           lower(coalesce(x.sport, '')) IN ('general', 'base') AS is_base
    FROM public.assessments x WHERE x.id = p_assessment_id
  ),
  -- Jim closed the hip flexion rule: never judged against 120. true = hip flexion is never ranked (not a weak spot) and a stored
  -- worst_joints entry for it is ignored. Set to false to restore the old ranking. Retired when #74 ships.
  -- FG-36: hip flexion is ranked only for assessments created at or after the scoring cutover; older ones keep today's ranking.
  cfg AS (SELECT NOT coalesce((SELECT a.a_created >= c.effective_at FROM a, public.scoring_cutovers c WHERE c.key = 'hip_flex_scored'), false) AS hip_flex_unscored),
  joint_defs(ord, key, left_key, right_key, single_key, normal_min, target) AS (VALUES
    (1, 'hip_er', 'hip_er_l', 'hip_er_r', NULL::text, 23::numeric, 23::numeric),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset: 29 -> 23 (normal_min = target);  -- Oct 6 2026: target was 45; normal_min 40 -> 29 (= Base target, minimums rescale)
    (2, 'hip_ir', 'hip_ir_l', 'hip_ir_r', NULL, 24, 24),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset: 26 -> 24;  -- Oct 6 2026: target was 45; normal_min 30 -> 26 (= Base target, minimums rescale)
    (3, 'hip_abd', 'hip_abd_l', 'hip_abd_r', NULL, 40, 40),  -- Oct 6 2026: target was 90
    (4, 'hip_flex', 'hip_flex_l', 'hip_flex_r', NULL, 60, public.hip_flex_target()),  -- FG-36 Nov 2 2026: target = hip_flex_target() (matches compute_joint_scores)  -- Oct 6 2026: normal_min 100 -> 60 (SLR target 60; row unused while hip_flex_unscored)
    (5, 'shoulder_er', 'shoulder_er_l', 'shoulder_er_r', NULL, 85, 85),  -- Oct 6 2026 8:19 PM: standing goal-post, normal_min 60 -> 85, target 40 -> 85
    (6, 'shoulder_flex', 'shoulder_flex_l', 'shoulder_flex_r', NULL, 141, 141),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset: 140 -> 141;  -- Oct 6 2026: target was 180
    (7, 'ankle_df', 'ankle_df_l', 'ankle_df_r', NULL, 6.1, 6.1),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset: 6 -> 6.1 cm;  -- Oct 6 2026: target was 20 cm; normal_min 10 -> 6 cm (= Base target, minimums rescale)
    (8, 'lumbar_flex', NULL, NULL, 'lumbar_flex', 40, 60),
    (9, 'lumbar_ext', NULL, NULL, 'lumbar_ext', 20, 25),
    (10, 'cervical_rot', 'cervical_rot_l', 'cervical_rot_r', NULL, 70, 70),  -- Oct 6 2026: target was 80
    (11, 'cervical_ext', NULL, NULL, 'cervical_ext', 48, 48),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset: 60 -> 48;  -- Oct 19 2026: = compute_joint_scores target 60 (Quinn memo, PMID 24573069; Base app main mobilityBands.ts:74)
    (12, 'cervical_flex', NULL, NULL, 'cervical_flex', 39, 39),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset: 50 -> 39;  -- Oct 19 2026: = compute_joint_scores target 50 (Quinn memo, PMID 24573069; Base app main mobilityBands.ts:73)
    (13, 'cervical_lat', 'cervical_lat_l', 'cervical_lat_r', NULL, 37, 37)  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset: 38 -> 37;  -- Oct 19 2026: side bend 38 per side (Jim Oct 6; Swinkels; = live compute_joint_scores target 38)
  ),
  problem AS (
    SELECT t.base_key, (row_number() OVER (ORDER BY t.first_ord) - 1)::int AS idx
    FROM (
      SELECT regexp_replace(w, '_(l|r)$', '') AS base_key, min(o) AS first_ord
      FROM a, cfg, unnest(a.worst_joints) WITH ORDINALITY AS u(w, o)
      WHERE coalesce(w, '') <> ''
        AND NOT (cfg.hip_flex_unscored AND regexp_replace(w, '_(l|r)$', '') = 'hip_flex')
        AND w NOT IN ('lumbar_flex', 'lumbar_ext')   -- Grant Oct 21 2026 7:10 PM: low back never ranked
      GROUP BY 1
    ) t
  ),
  vals AS (
    SELECT d.*, (a.j ->> d.left_key)::numeric AS lv, (a.j ->> d.right_key)::numeric AS rv,
           (a.j ->> d.single_key)::numeric AS sv, a.is_base
    FROM joint_defs d CROSS JOIN a
  ),
  scored AS (
    SELECT v.ord, v.key, v.is_base,
      CASE WHEN v.lv IS NOT NULL AND v.rv IS NOT NULL THEN abs(v.lv - v.rv) ELSE 0 END AS asym_legacy,
      CASE WHEN v.lv IS NOT NULL AND v.rv IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(0, v.normal_min - least(v.lv, v.rv))
           WHEN v.sv IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(0, v.normal_min - v.sv) ELSE 0 END AS sev_legacy,
      CASE WHEN v.lv IS NOT NULL AND v.rv IS NOT NULL THEN round(abs(v.lv - v.rv) * 10) / 10 ELSE 0 END AS asym_base,
      CASE WHEN v.lv IS NOT NULL AND v.rv IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(0, v.target - least(v.lv, v.rv))
           WHEN v.sv IS NOT NULL THEN greatest(0, v.target - v.sv) ELSE 0 END AS sev_base,
      CASE WHEN p.idx < 3 THEN p.idx END AS problem_idx
    FROM vals v LEFT JOIN problem p ON p.base_key = v.key CROSS JOIN cfg
    WHERE (v.lv IS NOT NULL OR v.rv IS NOT NULL OR v.sv IS NOT NULL)
      AND NOT (cfg.hip_flex_unscored AND v.key = 'hip_flex')
      AND v.key NOT IN ('lumbar_flex', 'lumbar_ext')   -- Grant Oct 21 2026 7:10 PM: low back never ranked
  ),
  ranked AS (
    SELECT s.key,
      row_number() OVER (ORDER BY
        CASE WHEN s.is_base THEN coalesce(s.problem_idx, 1000000) ELSE 0 END,
        CASE WHEN s.is_base THEN s.asym_base ELSE s.asym_legacy END DESC,
        CASE WHEN s.is_base THEN s.sev_base ELSE s.sev_legacy END DESC,
        CASE WHEN s.is_base THEN s.ord ELSE 0 END
      )::int AS rnk
    FROM scored s
  )
  SELECT r.key, r.rnk FROM ranked r WHERE r.rnk <= 3 ORDER BY r.rnk;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.compute_joint_scores(p_assessment_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  -- (superseded by FG-36 Nov 2 2026) Oct 3 note: hip flexion was unscored because 120 was unreachable; Jim overrode: 120 stays, it is scored to show what needs focus.
  -- true = hip flexion is stored on the assessment but gets NO joint_scores row (no band, not in the /100, never a weak spot).
  -- Set to false to restore the old behavior. Retired when the sex-specific norm engine (romrxbjj-v2 #74) ships.
  c_hip_flex_unscored boolean := true;   -- FG-36: no longer a constant flag; decided per assessment by the cutover below (true only for pre-cutover assessments)
  v_written int := 0;
  v_cut timestamptz;
  v_created timestamptz;
  v_a jsonb;
BEGIN
  SELECT to_jsonb(a) INTO v_a FROM public.assessments a WHERE a.id = p_assessment_id;
  -- FG-36 (Nov 2 2026): hip flexion is scored for assessments created at or after the cutover only. Older assessments keep
  -- exactly the rows they have today (no hip_flex row), even if this function is re-run (recompute_user_eligibility does that).
  SELECT effective_at INTO v_cut FROM public.scoring_cutovers WHERE key = 'hip_flex_scored';
  v_created := (v_a ->> 'created_at')::timestamptz;
  c_hip_flex_unscored := NOT (v_cut IS NOT NULL AND v_created IS NOT NULL AND v_created >= v_cut);
  IF v_a IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','assessment_not_found','assessment_id',p_assessment_id);
  END IF;

  WITH bilateral(joint_key, lcol, rcol, target) AS (
    VALUES
      ('hip_er','hip_er_l','hip_er_r',23::numeric),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset (PMIDs 9742472, 1881956): was 29
      ('hip_ir','hip_ir_l','hip_ir_r',24),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset (PMIDs 9742472, 1881956): was 26
      ('hip_abd','hip_abd_l','hip_abd_r',40),  -- Oct 6 2026: was 90
      ('hip_flex','hip_flex_l','hip_flex_r',public.hip_flex_target()),  -- FG-36: target comes from the one swappable config hip_flex_target() (120, Jim Nov 2 2026)
      ('shoulder_er','shoulder_er_l','shoulder_er_r',85),  -- Oct 6 2026 8:19 PM: standing goal-post test (was 40 tucked elbow; 90 before)
      ('shoulder_flex','shoulder_flex_l','shoulder_flex_r',141),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset (PMIDs 33046038): was 140
      ('ankle_df','ankle_df_l','ankle_df_r',6.1),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset (PMIDs 41723909): was 6 cm
      ('cervical_rot','cervical_rot_l','cervical_rot_r',70),  -- Oct 6 2026: was 80 (Swinkels 2014)
      ('cervical_lat','cervical_lat_l','cervical_lat_r',37)  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset (PMIDs 23829201, 32626769, 33868830, 39677250): was 38
  ),
  single(joint_key, col, target) AS (
    VALUES
      ('lumbar_flex','lumbar_flex',60::numeric),
      ('lumbar_ext','lumbar_ext',25),
      ('cervical_flex','cervical_flex',39),  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset (PMIDs 23829201, 32626769, 33868830, 39677250): was 50
      ('cervical_ext','cervical_ext',48)  -- Oct 21 2026 range reset (PMIDs 23829201, 32626769, 33868830, 39677250): was 60
  ),
  bi AS (
    SELECT b.joint_key, (v_a ->> b.lcol)::numeric AS left_value, (v_a ->> b.rcol)::numeric AS right_value, b.target FROM bilateral b
  ),
  si AS (
    SELECT s.joint_key, (v_a ->> s.col)::numeric AS left_value, NULL::numeric AS right_value, s.target FROM single s
  ),
  u AS (SELECT * FROM bi UNION ALL SELECT * FROM si),
  scored AS (
    SELECT joint_key, left_value, right_value, target,
      CASE WHEN left_value IS NOT NULL AND right_value IS NOT NULL THEN LEAST(left_value, right_value) WHEN left_value IS NOT NULL THEN left_value WHEN right_value IS NOT NULL THEN right_value ELSE NULL END AS worse,
      CASE WHEN left_value IS NOT NULL AND right_value IS NOT NULL AND GREATEST(left_value,right_value) > 0 THEN ROUND(ABS(left_value - right_value) / GREATEST(left_value, right_value) * 100, 2) ELSE NULL END AS asymmetry_pct
    FROM u
  ),
  final AS (
    SELECT joint_key, left_value, right_value, asymmetry_pct,
      public.t1_joint_band(joint_key, worse, target) AS score  -- T1 option A (rebased Oct 21 2026): buffer on hip_abd, cervical_rot, shoulder_er only
    FROM scored WHERE worse IS NOT NULL AND NOT (c_hip_flex_unscored AND joint_key = 'hip_flex')
  ),
  ins AS (
    INSERT INTO public.joint_scores (assessment_id, joint_key, score, left_value, right_value, asymmetry_pct, asymmetry_flag)
    SELECT p_assessment_id, joint_key, score, left_value, right_value, asymmetry_pct, NULL FROM final
    ON CONFLICT (assessment_id, joint_key) DO UPDATE SET score = EXCLUDED.score, left_value = EXCLUDED.left_value, right_value = EXCLUDED.right_value, asymmetry_pct = EXCLUDED.asymmetry_pct
    RETURNING 1
  )
  SELECT count(*) INTO v_written FROM ins;

  DELETE FROM public.joint_scores js
  WHERE js.assessment_id = p_assessment_id
    AND js.joint_key NOT IN (
      SELECT joint_key FROM (
        WITH bilateral(joint_key, lcol, rcol) AS (
          VALUES ('hip_er','hip_er_l','hip_er_r'),('hip_ir','hip_ir_l','hip_ir_r'),('hip_abd','hip_abd_l','hip_abd_r'),('hip_flex','hip_flex_l','hip_flex_r'),('shoulder_er','shoulder_er_l','shoulder_er_r'),('shoulder_flex','shoulder_flex_l','shoulder_flex_r'),('ankle_df','ankle_df_l','ankle_df_r'),('cervical_rot','cervical_rot_l','cervical_rot_r'),('cervical_lat','cervical_lat_l','cervical_lat_r')
        ),
        single(joint_key, col) AS (
          VALUES ('lumbar_flex','lumbar_flex'),('lumbar_ext','lumbar_ext'),('cervical_flex','cervical_flex'),('cervical_ext','cervical_ext')
        )
        SELECT joint_key FROM bilateral WHERE ((v_a ->> lcol) IS NOT NULL OR (v_a ->> rcol) IS NOT NULL) AND NOT (c_hip_flex_unscored AND joint_key = 'hip_flex')
        UNION ALL
        SELECT joint_key FROM single WHERE (v_a ->> col) IS NOT NULL
      ) present
    );

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('status','ok','assessment_id',p_assessment_id,'written',v_written);
END;
$function$

functions.def:
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.recompute_user_eligibility(p_user_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_assessment   assessments%ROWTYPE;
  v_sports       text[];
  v_sport        text;
  v_now          timestamptz := now();
  v_result       jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_written      int;
BEGIN
  SELECT array_remove(COALESCE(sports_enabled, ARRAY['general']::text[]), 'general')
    INTO v_sports
    FROM users WHERE id = p_user_id;

  IF v_sports IS NULL OR array_length(v_sports, 1) IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('user_id', p_user_id, 'status', 'no_owned_sports');
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_assessment
    FROM assessments
   WHERE user_id = p_user_id
   ORDER BY assessed_at DESC NULLS LAST, created_at DESC NULLS LAST
   LIMIT 1;

  IF v_assessment.id IS NULL THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('user_id', p_user_id, 'status', 'no_assessment');
  END IF;

  BEGIN
    PERFORM public.compute_joint_scores(v_assessment.id);
  EXCEPTION WHEN OTHERS THEN
    NULL;
  END;

  FOREACH v_sport IN ARRAY v_sports LOOP
    IF v_sport NOT IN ('bjj', 'bodybuilding') THEN
      v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object(v_sport, 'skipped_no_catalog');
      CONTINUE;
    END IF;

    WITH
    av AS (
      SELECT
        LEAST(v_assessment.hip_er_l,        v_assessment.hip_er_r)        AS hip_er,
        LEAST(v_assessment.hip_ir_l,        v_assessment.hip_ir_r)        AS hip_ir,
        LEAST(v_assessment.hip_abd_l,       v_assessment.hip_abd_r)       AS hip_abd,
        LEAST(v_assessment.hip_flex_l,      v_assessment.hip_flex_r)      AS hip_flex,
        LEAST(v_assessment.shoulder_er_l,   v_assessment.shoulder_er_r)   AS shoulder_er,
        LEAST(v_assessment.shoulder_flex_l, v_assessment.shoulder_flex_r) AS shoulder_flex,
        LEAST(v_assessment.ankle_df_l,      v_assessment.ankle_df_r)      AS ankle_df,
        LEAST(v_assessment.cervical_rot_l,  v_assessment.cervical_rot_r)  AS cervical_rot,
        LEAST(v_assessment.cervical_lat_l,  v_assessment.cervical_lat_r)  AS cervical_lat,
        v_assessment.lumbar_flex   AS lumbar_flex,
        v_assessment.lumbar_ext    AS lumbar_ext,
        v_assessment.cervical_flex AS cervical_flex,
        v_assessment.cervical_ext  AS cervical_ext
    ),
    reqs AS (
      SELECT t.id AS technique_id, t.code AS technique_code,
             j.joint, j.thresh, j.aval
      FROM techniques t
      CROSS JOIN LATERAL (
        VALUES
          ('hip_er',        t.hip_er_min,        (SELECT hip_er FROM av)),
          ('hip_ir',        t.hip_ir_min,        (SELECT hip_ir FROM av)),
          ('hip_abd',       t.hip_abd_min,       (SELECT hip_abd FROM av)),
          ('hip_flex',      t.hip_flex_min,      (SELECT hip_flex FROM av)),
          ('shoulder_er',   t.shoulder_er_min,   (SELECT shoulder_er FROM av)),
          ('shoulder_flex', t.shoulder_flex_min, (SELECT shoulder_flex FROM av)),
          ('ankle_df',      t.ankle_df_min,      (SELECT ankle_df FROM av)),
          ('cervical_rot',  t.cervical_rot_min,  (SELECT cervical_rot FROM av)),
          ('cervical_lat',  t.cervical_lat_min,  (SELECT cervical_lat FROM av)),
          ('lumbar_flex',   t.lumbar_flex_min,   (SELECT lumbar_flex FROM av)),
          ('lumbar_ext',    t.lumbar_ext_min,    (SELECT lumbar_ext FROM av)),
          ('cervical_flex', t.cervical_flex_min, (SELECT cervical_flex FROM av)),
          ('cervical_ext',  t.cervical_ext_min,  (SELECT cervical_ext FROM av))
      ) AS j(joint, thresh, aval)
      WHERE t.sport = v_sport
        AND j.thresh IS NOT NULL AND j.thresh <> 0
    ),
    per_tech AS (
      SELECT
        t.id AS technique_id, t.code AS technique_code,
        MIN(CASE WHEN r.aval IS NOT NULL THEN r.aval / r.thresh END) AS worst_ratio,
        BOOL_OR(r.aval IS NULL) AS any_missing,
        COUNT(r.joint) AS req_count,
        ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY_AGG(
          CASE WHEN r.aval IS NOT NULL AND r.aval / r.thresh < 0.90
               THEN r.joint || ':' || fmt_num(r.aval) || ' vs min ' || fmt_num(r.thresh) END
        ), NULL) AS below_band,
        ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY_AGG(
          CASE WHEN r.aval IS NOT NULL AND r.aval / r.thresh >= 0.90 AND r.aval / r.thresh < 1.0
               THEN r.joint || ':' || fmt_num(r.aval) || ' vs min ' || fmt_num(r.thresh) END
        ), NULL) AS band,
        ARRAY_REMOVE(ARRAY_AGG(
          CASE WHEN r.aval IS NULL
               THEN r.joint || ':not_measured(min ' || fmt_num(r.thresh) || ')' END
        ), NULL) AS missing
      FROM techniques t
      LEFT JOIN reqs r ON r.technique_id = t.id
      WHERE t.sport = v_sport
      GROUP BY t.id, t.code
    ),
    classified AS (
      SELECT
        technique_id, technique_code,
        CASE
          WHEN req_count = 0 THEN 'GREEN'
          WHEN worst_ratio IS NOT NULL AND worst_ratio < 0.90 THEN 'RED'
          WHEN any_missing OR (worst_ratio IS NOT NULL AND worst_ratio < 1.0) THEN 'YELLOW'
          ELSE 'GREEN'
        END AS tier,
        CASE
          WHEN req_count = 0 THEN ARRAY[]::text[]
          WHEN worst_ratio IS NOT NULL AND worst_ratio < 0.90
               THEN COALESCE(below_band, ARRAY[]::text[])
          WHEN any_missing OR (worst_ratio IS NOT NULL AND worst_ratio < 1.0)
               THEN COALESCE(band, ARRAY[]::text[]) || COALESCE(missing, ARRAY[]::text[])
          ELSE ARRAY[]::text[]
        END AS limiting_joints
      FROM per_tech
    )
    INSERT INTO technique_eligibility
      (user_id, athlete_id, assessment_id, technique_id, technique_code, sport, tier, limiting_joints, computed_at)
    SELECT
      p_user_id, v_assessment.athlete_id, v_assessment.id, c.technique_id, c.technique_code,
      v_sport, c.tier, c.limiting_joints, v_now
    FROM classified c
    ON CONFLICT (user_id, assessment_id, technique_id)
    DO UPDATE SET
      tier = EXCLUDED.tier,
      limiting_joints = EXCLUDED.limiting_joints,
      technique_code = EXCLUDED.technique_code,
      sport = EXCLUDED.sport,
      athlete_id = EXCLUDED.athlete_id,
      computed_at = EXCLUDED.computed_at;

    GET DIAGNOSTICS v_written = ROW_COUNT;
    v_result := v_result || jsonb_build_object(v_sport, v_written);
  END LOOP;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'user_id', p_user_id,
    'assessment_id', v_assessment.id,
    'status', 'ok',
    'written', v_result
  );
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.handle_new_user()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_sport text := coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data->>'active_sport', 'general');
  v_athlete_id uuid;
  v_lead record;
  v_ad jsonb;
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.ensure_public_user_profile(
    new.id, new.email, coalesce(new.raw_user_meta_data, '{}'::jsonb)
  );

  SELECT id INTO v_athlete_id FROM public.athletes WHERE user_id = new.id;

  IF NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.assessments a WHERE a.user_id = new.id) THEN
    SELECT l.id, l.assessment_data
      INTO v_lead
      FROM public.leads l
      WHERE l.email = new.email
        AND l.assessment_data IS NOT NULL
        AND l.created_at >= now() - interval '30 days'
        AND l.converted_user_id IS NULL
      ORDER BY l.created_at DESC
      LIMIT 1;

    IF v_lead.id IS NOT NULL AND v_athlete_id IS NOT NULL THEN
      v_ad := v_lead.assessment_data;
      INSERT INTO public.assessments (
        user_id, athlete_id, sport, assessed_at,
        hip_er_l, hip_er_r, hip_ir_l, hip_ir_r,
        hip_abd_l, hip_abd_r, hip_flex_l, hip_flex_r,
        ankle_df_l, ankle_df_r,
        shoulder_er_l, shoulder_er_r, shoulder_flex_l, shoulder_flex_r,
        lumbar_flex, lumbar_ext,
        cervical_flex, cervical_ext, cervical_lat_l, cervical_lat_r
      ) VALUES (
        new.id, v_athlete_id, v_sport, now(),
        (v_ad->>'hip_er_l')::numeric, (v_ad->>'hip_er_r')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'hip_ir_l')::numeric, (v_ad->>'hip_ir_r')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'hip_abd_l')::numeric, (v_ad->>'hip_abd_r')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'hip_flex_l')::numeric, (v_ad->>'hip_flex_r')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'ankle_df_l')::numeric, (v_ad->>'ankle_df_r')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'shoulder_er_l')::numeric, (v_ad->>'shoulder_er_r')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'shoulder_flex_l')::numeric, (v_ad->>'shoulder_flex_r')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'lumbar_flex')::numeric, (v_ad->>'lumbar_ext')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'cervical_flex')::numeric, (v_ad->>'cervical_ext')::numeric,
        (v_ad->>'cervical_lat_l')::numeric, (v_ad->>'cervical_lat_r')::numeric
      );

      UPDATE public.leads
        SET converted_user_id = new.id, converted_at = now()
        WHERE id = v_lead.id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN new;
END;
$function$

AS $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.persist_protocols_for_assessment(p_assessment_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  a public.assessments%ROWTYPE;
  v_written int := 0;
  v_joints text[];
  v_ranked text[];
BEGIN
  SELECT * INTO a FROM public.assessments WHERE id = p_assessment_id;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN
    RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', false, 'error', 'assessment_not_found');
  END IF;

  DELETE FROM public.protocols WHERE assessment_id = p_assessment_id;

  INSERT INTO public.protocols (assessment_id, user_id, exercise_id, joint_key, priority_rank)
  SELECT p_assessment_id, a.user_id, x.exercise_id, x.joint_key, x.priority_rank
  FROM (
    WITH ranked AS (
      SELECT r.joint_key AS key, r.priority_rank AS rank
      FROM public.protocol_joint_ranking(p_assessment_id) r
    ),
    aliases AS (
      SELECT r.key, r.rank, unnest(CASE r.key
        WHEN 'hip_abd' THEN ARRAY['hip_abd','hip_abduction']
        WHEN 'hip_flex' THEN ARRAY['hip_flex','hip_flexion']
        WHEN 'shoulder_flex' THEN ARRAY['shoulder_flex','shoulder_flexion']
        WHEN 'lumbar_flex' THEN ARRAY['lumbar_flex','lumbar_flexion']
        WHEN 'lumbar_ext' THEN ARRAY['lumbar_ext','lumbar_extension']
        WHEN 'cervical_rot' THEN ARRAY['cervical_rot','cervical_rotation']
        WHEN 'cervical_ext' THEN ARRAY['cervical_ext','cervical_extension']
        WHEN 'cervical_flex' THEN ARRAY['cervical_flex','cervical_flexion']
        WHEN 'cervical_lat' THEN ARRAY['cervical_lat','cervical_lateral_flexion']
        ELSE ARRAY[r.key] END) AS joint_key_alias
      FROM ranked r
    ),
    preferred AS (
      SELECT * FROM (VALUES
        ('ankle_df','resistance','Knee-to-Wall Mobilization'),
        ('ankle_df','stretch','Standing Gastrocnemius Stretch (Straight Knee)'),
        ('ankle_df','foam_roll','Calf Foam Roll'),
        ('hip_er','resistance','Clamshell with Band'),
        ('hip_er','stretch','Supine Figure-4 Stretch (Piriformis)'),
        ('hip_er','foam_roll','Piriformis/Glute Foam Roll'),
        ('hip_ir','resistance','Seated Banded Hip Internal Rotation'),
        ('hip_ir','stretch','90/90 Internal Rotation Stretch'),
        ('hip_ir','foam_roll','TFL/Lateral Hip Foam Roll'),
        ('hip_abd','resistance','Side-Lying Hip Abduction with Band'),
        ('hip_abd','stretch','Frog Stretch'),
        ('hip_abd','foam_roll','Adductor/Inner Thigh Foam Roll')
      ) AS t(joint_key, exercise_type, name)
    ),
    candidates AS (
      SELECT DISTINCT ON (al.key, e.exercise_type, lower(trim(e.name)))
        al.key AS joint_key,
        al.rank::smallint AS priority_rank,
        e.id AS exercise_id,
        e.exercise_type,
        e.name,
        (CASE WHEN e.sets IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
          + coalesce(length(e.reps),0)
          + coalesce(length(e.coaching_cue),0) AS richness
      FROM aliases al
      JOIN public.exercises e ON e.joint_key = al.joint_key_alias
      WHERE e.sports @> ARRAY['general']::text[]
        AND e.exercise_type IN ('resistance','stretch','foam_roll')
      ORDER BY al.key, e.exercise_type, lower(trim(e.name)),
        (CASE WHEN e.sets IS NOT NULL THEN 2 ELSE 0 END)
          + coalesce(length(e.reps),0)
          + coalesce(length(e.coaching_cue),0) DESC
    )
    SELECT DISTINCT ON (c.joint_key, c.exercise_type)
      c.joint_key, c.priority_rank, c.exercise_id
    FROM candidates c
    LEFT JOIN preferred p
      ON p.joint_key = c.joint_key AND p.exercise_type = c.exercise_type
    ORDER BY c.joint_key, c.exercise_type,
      CASE WHEN p.name IS NOT NULL AND c.name = p.name THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,
      c.richness DESC,
      c.name
  ) x;

  GET DIAGNOSTICS v_written = ROW_COUNT;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(DISTINCT joint_key ORDER BY joint_key), ARRAY[]::text[])
    INTO v_joints FROM public.protocols WHERE assessment_id = p_assessment_id;
  SELECT coalesce(array_agg(r.joint_key ORDER BY r.priority_rank), ARRAY[]::text[])
    INTO v_ranked FROM public.protocol_joint_ranking(p_assessment_id) r;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object('ok', true, 'written', v_written, 'joints', to_jsonb(v_joints), 'ranked', to_jsonb(v_ranked));
END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.t1_joint_band(p_joint_key text, p_worse numeric, p_target numeric)
 RETURNS smallint
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT (CASE
    WHEN p_worse IS NULL OR p_target IS NULL OR p_target <= 0 THEN 1
    WHEN NOT public.t1_is_narrow(p_joint_key) THEN
      CASE WHEN p_worse/p_target >= 1.0 THEN 3 WHEN p_worse/p_target >= 0.90 THEN 2 ELSE 1 END
    WHEN p_worse + public.t1_narrow_buffer(p_joint_key, 'steady') >= p_target THEN 3
    WHEN p_worse + public.t1_narrow_buffer(p_joint_key, 'building') >= 0.90 * p_target THEN 2
    ELSE 1 END)::smallint;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.t1_weighted_gap(p_joint_key text, p_worse numeric, p_target numeric, p_prev_worse numeric)
 RETURNS numeric
 LANGUAGE sql
 IMMUTABLE
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  SELECT CASE
    WHEN p_worse IS NULL OR p_target IS NULL OR p_target <= 0 THEN NULL
    WHEN public.t1_joint_band(p_joint_key, p_worse, p_target) = 3 THEN 0
    ELSE (1 - least(1, greatest(0, p_worse / p_target)))
      * CASE WHEN NOT public.t1_is_narrow(p_joint_key) THEN 1
             WHEN p_prev_worse IS NOT NULL
              AND public.t1_joint_band(p_joint_key, p_prev_worse, p_target) = public.t1_joint_band(p_joint_key, p_worse, p_target) THEN 1
             ELSE 0.5 END
  END;
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_weekly_volume(p_weeks integer DEFAULT 8)
 RETURNS TABLE(week_start date, muscle_group text, total_sets bigint, total_reps bigint, total_volume_kg numeric)
 LANGUAGE sql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
  WITH cutoff AS ( SELECT date_trunc('week', current_date)::date - (p_weeks * 7) AS d ),
       sets AS (
         SELECT ws.*,
                COALESCE(t.subcategory, 'Other') AS muscle_group
           FROM workout_sets ws
           LEFT JOIN techniques t ON t.id = ws.technique_id
          WHERE ws.user_id = auth.uid()
            AND ws.is_warmup = false
            AND ws.performed_at >= (SELECT d FROM cutoff)
       )
  SELECT date_trunc('week', performed_at)::date AS week_start,
         muscle_group,
         count(*)::bigint AS total_sets,
         COALESCE(sum(reps),0)::bigint AS total_reps,
         COALESCE(sum(weight_kg * reps),0)::numeric AS total_volume_kg
    FROM sets
   GROUP BY 1, 2
   ORDER BY 1 DESC, 2;
$function$

  ON CONFLICT (user_id, measured_at) DO UPDATE SET
    weight_kg = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.weight_kg, body_metrics.weight_kg),
    body_fat_pct = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.body_fat_pct, body_metrics.body_fat_pct),
    neck_cm = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.neck_cm, body_metrics.neck_cm),

    notes = COALESCE(EXCLUDED.notes, body_metrics.notes)
  RETURNING id INTO v_id;
  RETURN v_id;
END;
$function$

begin
  if current_user in ('postgres','supabase_admin','supabase_auth_admin','service_role','dashboard_user') then

  if new.id is distinct from old.id
     or new.email is distinct from old.email

     or new.portal_role is distinct from old.portal_role
     or new.school_id is distinct from old.school_id
     or new.coach_id is distinct from old.coach_id
     or new.platforms is distinct from old.platforms
     or new.sports_enabled is distinct from old.sports_enabled
     or new.subscription_status is distinct from old.subscription_status
     or new.subscription_tier is distinct from old.subscription_tier
     or new.subscription_expiry is distinct from old.subscription_expiry
     or new.stripe_customer_id is distinct from old.stripe_customer_id
     or new.stripe_subscription_id is distinct from old.stripe_subscription_id
